spec.query:
from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "actualRpm" or r["_field"] == "current")
  |> mean()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.current > 0.01)
  |> group()
  |> mean(column: "actualRpm")  
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with perc: r.actualRpm / 5200.0 }))

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "suctionPressure" or r["_field"] == "dischargePressure" or r["_field"] == "current")
  |> mean()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.current > 0.01)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with lift: r.dischargePressure - r.suctionPressure}))
  |> group()
  |> mean(column: "lift")

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "percentRla")
  |> group()
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pump" or r["_measurement"] == "power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "speedFb" or r["_field"] == "totalPower")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${assignedChwp}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with name: "${assignedChwp.text}"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["speedFb", "name", "totalPower"])

import "array"
import "timezone"
import "join"
import "date"

// Set the global location context
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

startTime = v.timeRangeStart
stopTime = v.timeRangeStop

energy =
    from(bucket: "cpms")
        |> range(start: startTime, stop: stopTime)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "${chiller}")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "energyUsage")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
        |> fill(value: 0.0)
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {_value: "kwh"})

cooling =
    from(bucket: "cpms")
        |> range(start: startTime, stop: stopTime)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "flow")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId == "${chiller}Chw")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "loadUsage")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
        |> fill(value: 0.0)
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {_value: "rth"})

dummyCooling = array.from(rows: [{
    _time: startTime,
    rth: 0.0,
    deviceId: "chiller3Chw"
}])

// 3. Union them together so the stream is never completely empty
safeCooling = union(tables: [cooling, dummyCooling])

join.inner(left: energy, right: safeCooling, 
on: (l, r) => l._time == r._time, 
as: (l,r) => ({ 
  _time: l._time,
  dow: date.weekDay(t: l._time),
  hour: date.hour(t: l._time),
  kwh: l.kwh,
  rth: r.rth,
  efficiency: if r.rth > 0.0 then l.kwh / r.rth else 0.0
}))
|> keep(columns: ["dow", "hour", "efficiency"])

import "join"
import "strings"

bucket = "cpms"
window = 15m

load =
  from(bucket: bucket)
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "flow")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.category == "chiller")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "energyFlowRate")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId =~ /chiller\dChw/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: window, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      deviceId: r.deviceId,
      loadRt: r._value * 78.986,
    }))
    |> group()


power =
  from(bucket: bucket)
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.category == "chiller")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "totalPower")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: window, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      chillerId: r.deviceId,
      loadId: r.deviceId + "Chw",
      powerKw: r._value,
    }))
    //|> group(columns: ["deviceId"])
    |> group()

running =
  from(bucket: bucket)
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "status")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "run")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId =~ /chiller/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: window, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 10)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      chillerId: r.deviceId,
      running: r._value,
    }))
    |> group()

loadPower =
  join.inner(
    left: load,
    right: power,
    on: (l, r) => l._time == r._time and l.deviceId == r.loadId,
    as: (l, r) => ({
      _time: l._time,
      chillerId: r.chillerId,
      loadRt: l.loadRt,
      powerKw: r.powerKw,
    }),
  )

join.inner(
  left: loadPower,
  right: running,
  on: (l, r) => l._time == r._time and l.chillerId == r.chillerId,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    chillerId: l.chillerId,
    loadRt: l.loadRt,
    kwPerRt: if l.loadRt > 0.0 then l.powerKw / l.loadRt else 0.0,
  }),
)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.loadRt > 0.0 and r.kwPerRt > 0.0)
  |> group(columns: ["chillerId"])

option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "current" or r["_field"] == "actualRpm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "deviceId", "current", "actualRpm"])

import "timezone"

// Set the global location context
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

data = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["chillerId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "compressor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "percentRla")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

avg = data
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "deviceId", value: "average")

union(tables: [data, avg])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "deviceId", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["deviceId"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

maxData = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] != "localRemote")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

minData = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "localRemote")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)

union(tables: [minData, maxData])
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value", "_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

import "join"

flow = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${chiller}Chw")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "energyFlowRate")
  |> mean()
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey:[], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with coolingLoad: r.energyFlowRate * 78.986 , chillerId: "${chiller}"}))

chiller = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "${chiller}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chiller" or r._measurement == "power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "actualCapacity" or r._field == "totalPower" )
  |> mean()
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey:[], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> set(key: "chillerId", value: "${chiller}")

join.inner(left: flow, right: chiller, on: (l, r) => l.chillerId == r.chillerId, 
  as: (l, r) => ({
    l with actualCapacity: r.actualCapacity,
    coolingCapacity: l.coolingLoad * 3.517,
    cop: l.coolingLoad * 3.517 / r.totalPower
  })
)
